For the frozen treat fans out there:

Sorbet is water-based, generally made out of fruit/fruit juices and water.
Gelato is ice cream that is stored and served at a warmer temperature.
Also Gelato tends to use more milk than cream.

In the US specifically, ice cream has to have more than 10% milk fat and 6-10% milk and non-milk solids.

comments.text:
Not counting dumb stuff like "protein coffee" or "protein water", I have to say that for me as a woman with PCOS, this protein trend is amazing!

A golden rule for us with PCOS is to never eat straight carbs due to insulin resistance, and we need more protein than most other women do as a baseline. Protein being added to carbs is amazing! I looove these new "rice cakes" that are made with peas and lentils to add fiber and protein. Rice cakes are murder for me and spike blood sugar, but these new protein products? Much smoother.
